cells.prompt:
Route the task to exactly one lane:
- survey: map an unfamiliar repo (files, layout, entry points)
- digest: current git state (branch, staged/unstaged, recent commits)
- diff: inspect or review the working diff / a revision
- test: run the project's test or check command and read the verdict
- ci: check or wait on CI status
- search: find where something is defined or used in the codebase
- fetch: read a web page or URL
- gate: run release gates (test+lint+typecheck+build) before shipping
- direct: none of the above — handle it yourself

default.name: Skill router
default.note: One classifier call maps a task description to the algal-skills lane that should handle it. This manifest is the malleable genotype: router-habitat evolves prompt and label set against labeled cases.

name: Router (live champion)
note: Routes through the champion manifest in the router-champion slot — the durable endpoint of router-habitat promotion. An empty slot serves the packaged default router via the slot's declared default.
